_help: Real photos of Amy's work only, with permission from any client whose face is shown.
Put files in src/images/gallery/ (WebP or JPG, about 1200px on the long side). style must match a service name for the filter.
Example photo: {"src": "images/gallery/knotless-waist-length.webp", "alt": "Waist-length knotless braids, back view", "style": "Knotless Braids", "width": 900, "height": 1200}

Before/after pairs show a comparison slider; only add genuine pairs of the same client: {"before": "images/gallery/x-before.webp", "after": "images/gallery/x-after.webp", "alt": "...", "style": "Box Braids"}
